Task: Quenching of Copper
Description: Simulate the quenching process of Copper using LAMMPS by cooling its molten structure under NPT conditions, followed by relaxation under NPT and NVT conditions. Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

- path to molten structure: /structures/task_29/heatedsystem_3000_reax.dat
- units: metal
- pbc: true
- timestep: 1 femtosecond
- npt quench steps: 20000

{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/quenching/brief/tasks/copper_quenching_trial_2/quench.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for Cu quenching

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

read_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/quenching/brief/tasks/copper_quenching_trial_2/cu.data

# EAM potential for Cu
pair_style eam
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Cu_u3.eam

# Initial minimization
minimize 1.0e-4 1.0e-6 100 1000

# Set timestep
timestep 0.001

# Create velocity
velocity all create 2000 12345 dist gaussian

# NPT quench from 2000K to 300K
fix 1 all npt temp 2000 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press vol density pe ke etotal
dump 1 all custom 1000 dump.quench id type x y z vx vy vz
run 20000
undump 1
unfix 1

# NPT relaxation at 300K
fix 2 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 10000
unfix 2

# NVT relaxation at 300K
fix 3 all nvt temp 300 300 0.1
run 10000
unfix 3

# Output final configuration
write_dump all custom final.dump id type x y z vx vy vz"}
